indicators.name: Natalità
indicators.caveat: Registri, censimenti e stime ONU; tasso grezzo, influenzato dalla struttura per età.
indicators.description: Crude birth rate indicates the number of live births occurring during the year, per 1,000 population estimated at midyear. Subtracting the crude death rate from the crude birth rate provides the rate of natural increase, which is equal to the rate of population change in the absence of migration.

indicators.name: Mortalità
indicators.caveat: Tasso grezzo: non confronta direttamente la salute di popolazioni con età diverse. Registri e stime ONU.
indicators.description: Crude death rate indicates the number of deaths occurring during the year, per 1,000 population estimated at midyear. Subtracting the crude death rate from the crude birth rate provides the rate of natural increase, which is equal to the rate of population change in the absence of migration.

indicators.name: Popolazione
indicators.caveat: Stime di popolazione a metà anno; definizioni e metodi variano. Non è un censimento simultaneo.
indicators.description: Total population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. The values shown are midyear estimates.

indicators.name: Speranza di vita
indicators.caveat: Indicatore di periodo da tavole di mortalità; non predice la vita di una singola persona.
indicators.description: Life expectancy at birth indicates the number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality at the time of its birth were to stay the same throughout its life.

indicators.name: Occupazione 15+
indicators.caveat: Stime modellate ILO, anche imputazioni: non usarle per classifiche fra paesi. Occupazione non equivale a lavoro dignitoso.
indicators.description: Employment to population ratio is the proportion of a country's population that is employed.
indicators.provider: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026
indicators.attribution: World Bank: World Development Indicators: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

indicators.name: Disoccupazione
indicators.caveat: Stime modellate ILO: denominatore diverso dall’occupazione 15+. Non misura povertà; imputazioni non adatte a classifiche fra paesi.
indicators.description: Unemployment refers to the share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
indicators.provider: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026
indicators.attribution: World Bank: World Development Indicators: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

indicators.name: Saldo naturale
indicators.caveat: Calcolo Upari sui due tassi originali, senza colmare anni mancanti. Non è crescita totale della popolazione.
indicators.description: Natalità meno mortalità nello stesso paese e anno. Non include migrazione.
